main_text.p: consistit, quòd Magistratus sit custos & vindex utriusque tabulæ & σὺλαξίας Ecclesiasticæ. Accedat exemplum commendatum à Spiritu Sancto, Principum scilicet Judæ, qui Jeremiam è manibus & violentiâ Sacerdotum e-ripuerunt Jerem. 26.16. &c. quod est argumentum Cl. Walæi p. 46. Denique si impunè liceret ministris abuti disciplinâ Ecclesiasticâ, ita ut non coërcerentur à Magistratu; certè nec Magistratus ipse, nec alius honestus vir tutus esse posset & securus officiorum & honorum suorum; maximè si velint imitari praxin Papatus, in quo privatio jurisdictionis & officiorum eorum etiam, quæ non pendent ab Electione Ecclesiæ, pari passu ambulant. Confirmat hoc argumentum praxis ejusdem papatus. page.notes: The Greek word after "tabulæ &" (read as σὺλαξίας) is not clear at this scan resolution; the reading is uncertain. The "&" in "tabulæ & ... Ecclesiasticæ" line is set in italic type, so the words are marked as such. The line "Jerem. 26.16." is set inline, not as a marginal note. The number 79 and running head are printed at the top; "D 4" is the signature at the foot. Google digitisation watermark at bottom right omitted.
